summary: Lewis & Clark County fire lookout cab with an L-4 design from the 1930s, listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Lists both Lolo and Helena National Forests

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com names both Lolo and Helena National Forests; Forest Lookouts names only Helena, with a township-range-section address. The story and facts use Helena.
A 1934 date on a firelookout.com page for a different Olson Peak (Mineral County) does not apply to this site, so it is not used. This site's cab is dated only to the 1930s.

notes_for_editor: Only two pages describe this site, both listing it as gone with no removal date. The record's coordinates (47.21687, -112.76182) were not checked against any source. Elevation 8,881 ft is about 2,707 m. The firelookout.com olsonpeak.html page, which describes a different Olson Peak in the Lolo National Forest, was removed from this record's sources; it is correctly linked from us-mt-olson-peak, the Mineral County record. Lolo/Helena forest wording is the firelookout.com page's own.
